options.notes: Directive (EU) 2026/470 allows Member States to relieve undertakings below either amended threshold for FY beginning 1 Jan 2025 – 31 Dec 2026. Record the national choice with its instrument citation.

_workflow: A country pack becomes usable ONLY when: (1) every requires_research field is resolved with an official citation, (2) golden profiles for the country pass, (3) an expert ratifies it, and (4) the member state is added to catalogues.json → ratified_country_packs with value true. Until then S-013 keeps final legal status at 'requires national review' for this country — that behaviour is deliberate.
